purpose: Authoritative cross-reference index for this repo's design decisions and research findings. Each entry has a stable, grep-able ID. The ID appears (1) as an HTML anchor in its canonical doc page, (2) as a [ID] token in code comments at every governed path, and (3) here. To find every place affected by a change: grep the ID across the repo, OR read this entry's `code_paths` + `appears_in`.

conventions.finding_id: F-<SLUG> — a verified fact about how Omarchy behaves
conventions.code_token: Comments in code reference IDs as [D-SLUG] / [F-SLUG] so grep finds both docs and code.
conventions.on_change: When a decision changes: update its canonical doc section, every doc in `appears_in`, every file in `code_paths`, and this registry entry (incl. `related`).

decisions.title: Lightweight shell + Omarchy CLI + stow; no Ansible, no convergence engine
One script (install) only; updates/cleanup are manual
Own thin fragments + single managed integration block; never symlink Omarchy-owned files
install must be idempotent (upsert_block + stow -R + pkg --needed)
Makefile is the single source of truth for repo operations (CI gates + `update` orchestrator + `verify` live health check); CI invokes it
uv and go are owned by omarchy's `install dev-env` path; `./install` actively drops pacman copies and reconciles to the dev-env install
Bash login shell (Omarchy default); no chsh to zsh
Aliases ported into shell.sh, sourced via ~/.bashrc managed block at EOF (ours win)
Secrets/host-specific values in gitignored *.local files
Carry ssh/bin/aliases/tmux/hypr-fragment/nvim-keymaps; drop i3/i3status/picom/ghostty/desktops/nvim-tree
Keep tmux (real customization); port clipboard xclip -> wl-copy for Wayland
nvim <leader>y maps via managed block in Omarchy's keymaps.lua; do NOT stow the nvim tree
caps->ctrl remap lives in the owned hypr fragment (sourced last), not Omarchy's input.conf
Workspace app-assignments as windowrules in the hypr fragment
External MX Master mouse accel in gitignored hypr.local.conf (device-specific)
Hyprland looknfeel deltas in the owned fragment: pin border_size = 2 past the window-no-gaps toggle, and round only floating windows via per-window windowrule (tiles stay omarchy-default square)
Declined vim hjkl window focus (keep Omarchy SUPER+arrows; preserve SUPER+J/L)
Personal waybar deltas as composed jq filters in waybar/deltas.jq, applied idempotently by install (apply_jq_deltas helper); restart waybar only when content changes
Reference baseline = Omarchy after 'Remove Preinstalled'; bindings.conf left untracked
Subtractive baseline overlay: packages.remove.txt + app-picker curation

Docked dual-monitor layout as desc:-matched monitor= rules in the hypr overlay (compositor scale 1.333333 → effective logical 1920×1080 per external); eDP-1 stays governed by Omarchy's lid switch + internal-monitor-disable toggle (no overlay line); GDK_SCALE intentionally untouched; install restarts waybar when reload changes monitor topology

findings.title: hyprland.conf sources defaults -> user override files -> theme -> toggles; later wins
omarchy refresh backs up but cp -f writes THROUGH symlinks, mutating tracked files
Omarchy dev branch already migrated Hyprland config to Lua
bash chain; ~/.bashrc sources Omarchy default then user section at EOF; known omarchy aliases
omarchy-nvim-setup cp -r replaces ~/.config/nvim; keymaps.lua is the user-extension file
Remove Preinstalled explains the trimmed bindings.conf (intentional, not drift)
Omarchy CLI surface (pkg add/aur/drop, refresh config, theme/font, update -y)
zsh vs bash on Omarchy: stay on bash (chsh->zsh breaks session; bash already has starship/zoxide/fzf/mise)
tmux prefers omarchy's ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf (XDG) over ~/.tmux.conf, shadowing it; we overlay via source-file and inherit omarchy's good tmux defaults

Omarchy mutates ~/.config/waybar/config.jsonc via two patterns: wholesale refresh-waybar overwrites AND surgical sed-style migrations; the manual's 'will not be overwritten' claim is inaccurate for waybar
AGENTS.md is the canonical agent-guidance file; CLAUDE.md is a one-line `@AGENTS.md` bridge so every harness reads the same instructions
Hyprland matches `monitor =` rules at startup AND on hot-plug; `desc:` is a documented prefix match (excluding the trailing portname); empty-`output` is a fallback only when no other rule matches

Omarchy's `omarchy-hyprland-monitor-scaling-cycle` (Super+/) auto-persists scale to monitors.conf only when the file matches a single `monitor=,preferred,auto,N` wildcard; multi-monitor desc:-rule layouts must persist scale by editing the user's overlay directly
